role: independent arithmetic from literal supplied values, not author self-check adoption

weakAcidTenfoldDilution.bounds: weak-acid low-dissociation approximation; fixed acid/temperature; water contribution negligible

dissolutionTransfer50C.interpretation: large repeat disagreement; no warranted trend conclusion before conditions checked

acidTitration.bounds: monoprotic 1:1; volumes consistent; common base-concentration error scales absolute values but cancels ratio

linearCalibration.bounds: these scatter-only values exclude standards, blank, pipette, regression and sample uncertainties

photometricTransfers.bounds: out-of-range raw absorbance is no validated concentration; actual diluted measurement and actual calibration needed; dilute blank-corrected signal, not total absorbance

firstOrderKinetics.bounds: isothermal supplied model; linearity does not establish unique mechanism; small original residuals from rounded inputs

solubilityModel.bounds: fictional monoprotic acid; intrinsic neutral solubility; same-scaffold mass equivalents; no precipitated additional salt; no clinical inference

processResourceUse.bounds: do not count internally recovered 60 kg as fresh; accepted product denominator; unlike units are not additive

reusablePackagingComparison.bounds: transport/wash/material units need impact factors before environmental aggregation

equilibriumModel.bounds: fixed stoichiometry/volume; ideal concentration convention; x must keep concentrations positive; temperature changes K separately from rate

receptorOccupancy.bounds: equilibrium free ligand, identical independent 1:1 sites, negligible depletion as simple model; occupancy is not activation or medical efficacy

stoichiometry.esterHydrolysis: R-C(=O)-O-Rprime + H2O -> R-C(=O)-OH + Rprime-OH; enzyme catalytic, not stoichiometrically consumed
